tldr:
The proved uniform minimax absolute-risk and finite \(0.90\)-honest connected-interval-length frontier for the independent-patient causal win contrast is
\[
 \rho(n,r)=\min\{1,n^{-1/2}+\min\{n^{-6/13},n^{-1/8}(r+1)^{-7/8}\}\}.
\]
Risk and honest length have this same order for every public \(n\ge2\) and \(0\le r\le n\), with explicit universal constants and no logarithmic factor. The inner orders cross at \(r+1=n^{5/13}\); root-\(n\) precision holds if and only if \(r_n=\Omega(n^{3/7})\), including arbitrary oscillating budget sequences. A total original-record Fourier procedure attains the frontier and finite coverage. A compact marked-mixture converse covers all Borel public-randomized procedures on the same entire compact \(H^1\) parent, retaining the validation schedule and treatment marks.
